description: Stopgap values transcribed from the cited catalogs without machine verification, used only until `npm run data:snapshot` captures a dated archive snapshot. Positions are ICRS J2000.0 as listed by SIMBAD (Gaia DR3 stars: the Gaia DR3 J2016.0 values) and are propagated to the target epoch by scripts/build-dataset.ts. Positions (J2000), proper motions, distances and spectral types from the HYG star database v4.0 (CC BY-SA 4.0). Extracted by scripts/extract-catalogs.ts; provisional until the archive snapshot verifies it.
